title: 皐月賞の後に・研ぎ澄ますは

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although Mejiro Ardan struggles to hide her disappointment after losing out at the Satsuki Sho, her steady strides away from the track are a sure sign of her growth.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan vows to capitalize on what she's learned today to ensure promising results at both the Aoba Sho and the Japanese Derby to follow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, motivated by their loss at the Satsuki Sho, Yaeno Muteki and Sakura Chiyono O each vow to seize victory at the Japanese Derby.
